rows.text: The key to piloting Tifa Lockhart is understanding its core engine: Tifa Lockhart doubles her power on every single land drop. With trample built-in, a single fetchland turns her from 2 power to 8 power, and a Scapeshift or double land drop easily hits 32+ power for one-shot commander knockouts.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Crop Rotation, The One Ring, Worldly Tutor. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
